Bitcoin (BTC) is the world\'s first decentralized peer-to-peer digital currency, designed to act as a store of value and digital gold.
Ethereum (ETH) is a decentralized smart contract platform that powers decentralized applications (dApps), DeFi, and Web3 ecosystems.
Tether (USDt) is a pioneer fiat-collateralized stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the US Dollar to provide stability in crypto markets.
BNB powers the BNB Chain ecosystem, offering utility for trading fee discounts, DeFi protocols, and smart contracts.
Solana (SOL) is a high-performance blockchain built for speed and low-cost transactions, supporting NFTs, DeFi, and Web3.
XRP is designed for fast, low-cost global cross-border payments and financial institution remittances.
USDC is a fully backed US Dollar stablecoin providing dollar liquidity and instant settlement across Web3.
Cardano (ADA) is a proof-of-stake blockchain platform designed for security, sustainability, and peer-reviewed smart contracts.
Dogecoin (DOGE) is an open-source peer-to-peer cryptocurrency born from internet meme culture with a vibrant community.
Avalanche (AVAX) is an ultra-fast smart contract platform designed for scalable enterprise and DeFi applications.
